hook: Rare footage: a Heights local leaving the Heights
caption:
Houston beta party: Jan 9.
Rare footage: a Heights local leaves the porch, the dog and the taco place, and crosses I-10 to Montrose. Home by 10, it says. Send this to your friend who never leaves the Heights.
